class Counter:
    def __init__(self, tag):
        self.tag = tag
        self.n = 0
        print(tag, 'built')

        print(self.tag, self.n)

a.tick()
b.tick()
a.tick()

class Team:
    def __init__(self, nam):
        self.name = nam
        self.players = list()

    def add_player(self, player):
        self.players.append(player)

    def describe(self):
        print('team: %s' % self.name)
        print('players: %d' % len(self.players))


class LoudTeam(Team):
    def describe(self):
        print('LOUD team: %s' % self.name.upper())
        print('players: %d' % len(self.players))

green.add_player('ana')
green.add_player('bo')
green.describe()

gold.add_player('cy')
